Job Title: SQL Database Developer 
 Location: Washington, DC 
 Contract Length: 6 month contract to hire 
 
 Interview Process: Phone, 2 onsite interviews with management teams to hire 
 
 Citizenship: EAD/GC, GC, or US Citizen, Strictly NO H1B or OPT-EAD. This client will not sponsor. 
 Hourly Rate: $40-45/hour 
 Conversion Salary: $110k MAX 
 Top Skills: SQL Server Databases 2008, 2012, 2016; T-SQL; Datawarehouse Technologies; Database Design; Business Intellignece 
 
 DETAILS ABOUT THE POSITION 
 The role will work with other members of the database development team and also the application development team to develop and maintain custom applications to support ACC’s core business systems. The Database Developer role is to assist in developing procedures, triggers, DTS and or SSIS packages, administer development databases and help troubleshoot and optimize SQL code while in development. The Database Developer is also expected to be able to design relational and analytical databases based on requirement documents provided by the project management team. Support other departments by providing assistance in creating or extracting data from ACC’s databases.
